title: FileBackup configuration (SR-042)
description: Versioned JSON configuration contract for FileBackup.ps1 -ConfigPath. Published as documentation/editor support; the hand-rolled PowerShell validator in Modules/FileBackup.Engine.psm1 (Import-BackupConfiguration) is the runtime authority. TC-077 pins the two against one fixture corpus so this file cannot drift from the validator. CLIXML configs are the unversioned legacy native-Windows form and are not covered by this schema.

ConfigVersion.description: Currently 1. A config declaring a higher version is refused by this build. JSON has one number type, so an integral-valued number IS that integer: 1.0 is accepted as 1 (both by this const and by the runtime validator); 1.5, 0, "1" and anything above 1 are refused.

BackupSets.description: One or more backup sets. An array of at least one set object, or -- matching the runtime validator, which wraps it -- a single bare set object.

SourceStatePath.description: Optional; defaults to SourcePath. Required in practice for a read-only container source.

AllowEmptySource.description: Optional; defaults to false. Set true only for an intentional delete-all.

secrets.description: Secrets.Credential is intentionally NOT a listed property: JSON cannot carry a PSCredential, and additionalProperties:false rejects it. Containerized runs are -NoMail.
